name: State machine violation in subscription upgrade flow

input.title: User can skip 'payment_required' state by replaying old upgrade request
input.summary: POST /subscription/upgrade transitions: pending → payment_required → active. Replaying a captured 'pending' state request after subscription is cancelled transitions the user to active without payment.

attacker.identity: authenticated user with previously cancelled subscription

input.root_cause: transition_to does not validate current state accepts upgrade event from this caller

rationale: Spec §39 hard bug recall target: state machine bug. Reproduced with saved request replay.
